title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: Byzantine Branch, Provenance Quarantine, and Reattestation Extension
revision_notes: Separates sincere contradictory witness from lineage-integrity failure.
Adds quarantine as preservation without authority rather than deletion.
Adds taint propagation so derived faces cannot wash broken provenance by replication.
Adds last-verified-checkpoint recovery and selective reattestation.
Requires independent evidence for restoring authority; suspect self-assertion is insufficient.

technical_primitives.QUARANTINE_SET: Preserved records excluded from normal authoritative proposal/commit paths.
technical_primitives.TAINT_LINEAGE: Derived states whose authority depends on a non-admitted ancestor.
technical_primitives.LAST_VERIFIED_CHECKPOINT: Newest admitted state before integrity failure.
technical_primitives.REATTESTATION_RECEIPT: Independent evidence binding a quarantined record back to an admitted lineage/evidence path.
technical_primitives.FORENSIC_RETENTION: Rule requiring suspect records to remain auditable unless separate retention rules require otherwise.

authority_state_machine.UNKNOWN: preserved but not promoted to authoritative fact/action source
authority_state_machine.QUARANTINED: inspectable but excluded from world-changing authority
authority_state_machine.REATTESTED: restored only after independent reconstruction or receipt; then re-enters normal admission

recovery_algorithm: freeze suspect suffix from external authority
preserve suspect bytes/semantic objects for forensics
replay admitted external receipts after the checkpoint
reconstruct parent-child lineage where independently possible
emit recovery receipt listing preserved, restored, and unresolved state

compatibility_with_previous_layers.identity_lineage: Quarantine does not erase face or host history.
compatibility_with_previous_layers.evidence_ledger: A quarantined memory may remain evidence of tampering while losing authority as evidence for its own asserted world claim.
compatibility_with_previous_layers.obligation_ledger: Obligations are not canceled solely because the local memory explaining them is quarantined; external obligation receipts remain separately evaluated.
compatibility_with_previous_layers.commit_channel: Quarantined-derived proposals cannot enter world commit unless independently reconstructed and admitted.

minimum_tests: quarantined record remains retrievable for audit
quarantined record cannot directly create external commit
1000 derivative faces do not restore authority
independent reattestation can restore one exact record without restoring unrelated suspect records
tamper_tests: change quarantined record to VALID without receipt
reattest entire branch using one unrelated receipt
hide taint through a new face ID
allow suspect branch to sign its own restoration as sole evidence

en: A damaged memory is not erased merely because it is unsafe to trust.
Quarantine preserves evidence while withholding authority.
A thousand copies of one broken source are still one broken source.
Recover from the last verified checkpoint; do not pretend the suspect suffix never existed.
Trust returns through independent reattestation, not through the suspect branch declaring itself healed.
